description: Answer the open step of a check from start_agent_check: the agent's tool calls (name and input, as the step's tools list gives them; several per step are fine), or text alone. AINDEX runs them as the agent's own (decide is checked and its orders placed under the owner's mode and limits) and returns the next step with the results, or how the check ended. With no calls, it waits for a step still being carried out. Needs an access key that may act.

step.description: The step waiting; left out, the one waiting on this check

name: agent_check_step
title: Answer a step of your agent's check
